senses.gloss: 1. अव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring, loving.

अव 2. अव or sometimes व, ind. (as a pre-
fix to verbs and nouns expresses) off, away, down;
implying sometimes depreciation, disrepect, diminu-
tion, &c.
. (As a separable adverb or preposition with abl.)
away, off, away from or down [cf. the Zend pron.
ava, to which corresponds the Slav. ovo, ova, ‘this,
that:’ cf. also the syllable αὐ in αὐ-τός, αὖ, αὖθι,
αὖθις, αὖτις, αὖτε, αὐτάρ; Lat. au-t, au-tem, &c.].

आव आव, the base of the dual cases of the
pronoun of the 1st person; Nom. Acc. आवाम् (Ved.
आवम्); Inst. Dat. Abl. आवाभ्याम्; Gen. Loc. आवयोस्.

आवा आ-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -तुम्, to blow
from all quarters, to blow upon; Desid. P. A.
-विवासति, -ते, to care for, be attentive to, favour.
अवन, अवनि, &c. See s.v.

अवन अवन, अम्, n. (rt. अव्), satisfaction;
joy, happiness; desire; favour, preserving, protection,
defence; speed; going, obtaining, asking; seizing,
killing; power; increase; existence; adorning; em-
bracing; bearing; entrance.

अवन; add — (अस्, ई, अम्), protecting, sheltering,
a protector.
1. अवान, अस्, m. breathing, inhaling.

अवान 2. अ-वान, अस्, आ, अम् (for अन्-अवान ?),
dried, dry. See वान.

अवकट, अस्, आ, अम्, opposite, contrary; back-
wards, downwards; (अम्), n. opposition, contrariety,
reverse.
अवकट, अवकुटार। See above.
अवकटिका, f. dissimulation.

अवकुटार, अस्, आ, अम्, opposite, contrary; back-
wards, downwards; (अम्), n. reverse, contrariety.
अवकुटारिका, f. dissimulation.

अवंश अ-वंश, अस्, m. a low or despised
family; (अम्), n., Ved. that which has no beams or
support, the ether.

अवकलित अव-कलित, अस्, आ, अम्, Seen, ob-
served; wicked, perverse (?).

अवका अवका, f. a grassy plant growing in
marshy land, Blyxa Octandra Rich; otherwise called
Śaivāla.
—अवकाद (˚का-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eat-
ing the plant Blyxa Oct. R.
—अवकोल्ब (˚का-उल्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, covered or surrounded with Avakā plants.
1. अ-वाक्क, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. speechless.

2. अवाक्क, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a word formed for
the etymology of अवका.

अवकाश् अव-काश्, cl. 1. 4. A. -काशते, -काश्-
यते, -शितुम्, to be visible, to be manifest: Caus.
P. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to look at: Intens.
part. -चाकशत्, अत्, अती, अत्, shining; seeing.

अव-काश, अस्, m. a glance cast on anything; N.
of certain verses, during the recitation of which the
eyes must be fixed on certain objects; place, space,
open or wide space, room, occasion, opportunity;
interval, aperture; intermediate time; अवकाशं
कृ or दा, to make room, to give way, to admit;
अवकाशं लभ्, to get a footing; to obtain a favour-
able opportunity; to find scope, happen, take place;
अवकाशं रुध्, not to give way; to hinder, im-
pede.
—अवकाश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, spacious.

अवकाश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, admitted in the recitation
of the Avakāśa verses.

अवकुञ्चन अव-कुञ्चन, अम्, n. bending,
curving, flexure, contraction.

अवकुट्टित अव-कुट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, vexed,
inflamed; cut off.

अवकुण्ठन अव-कुण्ठन, अम्, n. investing,
surrounding; attracting.

अव-कुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, invested, surrounded,
attracted.

अवकुत्स् अव-कुत्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -कुत्सयति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to blame, revile, contemn.

अव-कुत्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, reviled, despised; (अम्),
n. blame, censure.

अवकुष् अव-कुष्, cl. 9. P. -कुष्णाति, -कोषि-
तुम्, to draw or rub downwards; to prove (?); to
display (?).

अवकूल् अव-कूल्, cl. 10. P. -कूलयति, -यि-
तुम्, to singe, burn.

अवकृत् अव-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्ति-
तुम्, to cut off or away: Caus. P. -कर्तयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to cut off.
अव-कर्त, अस्, m. a part cut off, a strip.
अव-कर्तन, अम्, n. cutting off, excision.
अव-कर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, cutting off, cutting out.

अवकृष् अव-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति,
-कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw off or away, to pull
off or out, to extract, to take off; to drag down.

अव-कर्षण, अम्, n. taking or pulling out, off
or down, extraction; expulsion.

अव-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn away or down,
sent away, removed, dropped; expelled, turned out;
dragged down; being below; inferior, low; degraded,
outcast; (अस्), m. a servent who performs the lowest
office, a sweeper, a waterman, &c.
अव-कृष्य, ind. having drawn away or down.

अवाकृ अवा-कृ (अव-आ-कृ), cl. 8. 5. P.
-करोति, -कृणोति, -कर्तुम्, to remove.

अवाकॄ अवा-कॄ (अव-आ-कॄ), cl. 6. P. -किरति,
-करितुम्, -रीतुम्, to strew, pour upon.
अव-कर, अस्, m. dust or sweepings.
अवा-कर, अस्, m. a mint (?).

अव-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown off, left; scattered,
disregarded, violated, coarsely pounded.

अव-कीर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, violating a vow or engage-
ment of chastity, continence, temperance, &c.; (ई),
m. a religious student who has committed an act of
incontinency.
—अवकीर्णि-व्रत, अम्, n. penance for
an act of incontinency.

अव-कीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being scattered or
strewed.

अवकॢप् अव-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते, -पितुम्,
-प्तुम्, to correspond with, to answer; to be right;
to be fit; to help to, to serve: Caus. -कल्पयति,
-यितुम्, to put in order; to prepare, make ready;
to employ becomingly; to consider as possible:
Desid. of Caus. -चिकल्पयिषति, to wish to prepare
or to make ready.

अव-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, corresponding with, right,
fit.

अव-कॢप्ति, इस्, f. considering as possible; possi-
bility, suitableness.

अवकेश अव-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having
the hair hanging down.

अव-केशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, unfruitful, barren; (ई), m. a
tree without fruit.

अवकोकिल अव-कोकिल, अस्, आ, अम्, called
down to by the koïl (singing in a tree above?).
अवकोल्ब अवकोल्ब. See s. v. अवका.

अवक्तव्य अ-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वच्),
not to be said, improper; indescribable.

अवक्त्र अ-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having no mouth
(as a vessel).

अवक्र अ-वक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not crooked,
straight, upright, honest.

अवक्रक्षिन् अव-क्रक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (rt. क्रक्ष्
connected with कृष्?), Ved. dashing down, over-
coming.

अवक्रन्द् अव-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रन्दति,
-ते, -दितुम्, or Caus. P. -क्रन्दयति, -यितुम्, to
cry out, roar.
अव-क्रन्द, अस्, m., Ved. roaring, neighing.
अव-क्रन्दन, अम्, n. crying out, weeping aloud.

अवक्रम् अव-क्रम्, cl. 1. 4. P. -क्रामति,
-क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to step down or away, run
away, escape; to tread down, overcome; to descend:
Caus. P. -क्रमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go down.
अव-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. descending, descent; approach.
अव-क्रामिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. running away, escaping.

अवक्रिया अव-क्रिया, f. neglect, omission,
non-performance of prescribed acts.

अवक्री अव-क्री, cl. 9. P. A. -क्रीणाति, -णीते,
-क्रेतुम्, to purchase; to let out to hire; to bribe.

अव-क्रय, अस्, m. letting out to hire; rent; re-
venue; price.

अवक्रीड् अव-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रीडति, -ते,
-डितुम्, to play (?).

अवक्रुश् अव-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति, -क्रोष्-
टुम्, to call down to; to revile.

अव-क्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded ill or badly; re-
viled, abused.

अव-क्रोश, अस्, m. a discordant noise; a curse, an
imprecation; abuse.

अवक्लम् अव-क्लम्, ? Caus. P. -क्लमयति,
-यितुम्, to bring water for washing; (this word, given
by Westergaard, is doubtful.)

अवक्लेद अव-क्लेद, अस्, m. (rt. क्लिद्), trick-
ling, descent of moisture; ichor, malignant or fetid
discharge.

अव-क्लेदन, अम्, n. trickling, falling as dew or
moisture.

अवक्वण अव-क्वण, अस्, m. a discordant or
false note.

अवक्वाथ अव-क्वाथ, अस्, m. imperfect di-
gestion or decoction.

अवक्षर् अव-क्षर्, Caus. P. -क्षारयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to flow down upon.

अवक्षल् अव-क्षल्, cl. 10. P. -क्षालयति,
-यितुम्, to wash by dipping in.

अवक्षाम अव-क्षाम, अस्, m., Ved. pro-
pitiatory offering, satisfaction of claims, compensation.

अवक्षि अव-क्षि, cl. 9. 5. 1. P. -क्षिणाति,
-णोति, -क्षयति, -क्षेतुम्, to remove: Pass. -क्षी-
यते, to waste away.
अव-क्षय, अस्, m. destruction, waste, loss.

अव-क्षयण, अम्, n. a means for extinguishing
(a fire, &c.).
अव-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, wasted, emaciated.

अवक्षिप् अव-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति,
-ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw down; to cause to fly down
or away; to hurl; to reprimand, revile any one;
to grant, yield: Caus. P. -क्षेपयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to fall down.

अव-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown down, badly
thrown; said sarcastically, imputed, insinuated; blamed,
reviled.
अव-क्षेप, अस्, m. blaming, reviling, scolding.

अव-क्षेपण, अम्, n. throwing down, overcom-
ing; censure, blame; despising; (णी), f. rein, bridle.

अवक्षु अव-क्षु, cl. 2. P. -क्षौति, -क्षवि-
तुम्, to sneeze upon.
अव-क्षुत, अस्, आ, अम्, sneezed upon.

अवक्षुद् अव-क्षुद्, cl. 1. P. -क्षोदति, -दि-
तुम्, to stamp or pound; to rub to pieces.

अवक्षै अव-क्षै, cl. 1. P. -क्षायति, -क्षा-
तुम्, to burn down or to the end.
अव-क्षाण, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt down.

अवक्ष्णु अव-क्ष्णु, cl. 2. P. -क्ष्णौति,
-क्ष्णवितुम्, to rub to pieces.

अवखण्ड् अव-खण्ड्, cl. 10. P. -खण्डयति,
-यितुम्, to divide, annihilate, destroy.
अव-खण्डन, अम्, n. dividing, destroying.

अवखाद अव-खाद, अस्, m., Ved. a bad or
contemptible meal, eating to no purpose, an unworthy
oblation.

अवख्या अव-ख्या, cl. 2. P., Ved. -ख्याति,
-ख्यातुम्, to look down, perceive: Caus. P. -ख्या-
पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to look at.

अवगण् अव-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति, -यि-
तुम्, to disregard, disrepect, pay no attention; to
despise.
अव-गणन, अम्, n. contempt, disregard.
अव-गणित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded, despised.

अवगण अव-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, separated from
one's companions, isolated, alone.

अवगण्ड अव-गण्ड, अस्, m. a boil or pimple
upon the face.

अवगथ अव-गथ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. गा, to go),
bathing or bathed early in the morning.

अवगदित अव-गदित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. गद्),
unsaid, unuttered.

अवगम् अव-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go down, descend; to come to, visit; to go
near, undertake; to reach, obtain; to hit upon,
think of, conceive; to learn, understand, assure one's
self, be convinced; to recognize, consider: Caus. P.
-गमयति, -यितुम्, to bring near, procure; to cause
to know, teach.

अव-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, gone away; obtained,
[]
conceived, known, learnt, understood, comprehended;
assented, promised.

अव-गति, इस्, f. perception, knowledge, compre-
hension.

अव-गन्तव्य or अव-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
known or understood, to be judged, intended to be
understood, meant.

अव-गम, अस्, m. or अव-गमन, अम्, n. going
near, descending, understanding, comprehension, in-
telligence; knowledge, getting acquainted with.
अवगर्हित अव-गर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, despised.

अवगल् अव-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, -लितुम्,
to fall down, slip down.

अवगल्भ् अव-गल्भ्, cl. 1. A. -गल्भते,
-भितुम्, to be brave, valiant.

अवगाद अवगाद, अस्, m. a small wooden
bason for baling water out of a boat; (etym. doubtful.)

अवगाह् अव-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहि-
तुम्, -गाढुम्, to plunge into; to go deep into, to
be absorbed in (with loc. or acc.).

अव-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, immersed, bathed, plunged
into; that in which one bathes; deepened, low;
concealed, curdling (as blood).
—अवगाढ-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, bathing, plunging, diving.
अव-गाह, अस्, m. plunging, bathing; a bucket (?).

अव-गाहन, अम्, n. immersion, plunging, diving,
bathing.
अव-गाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed, immersed.

अवगुण्ठ् अव-गुण्ठ्, cl. 10. P. -गुण्ठयति,
-यितुम्, to cover with; to draw over, conceal.

अव-गुण्ठन, अम्, n. hiding, veiling, a veil; a
peculiar joining of the fingers in certain religious
ceremonies; sweeping.
—अवगुण्ठन-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, covered with a veil.
अव-गुण्ठिका, f. a veil.

अव-गुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, concealed,
veiled, screened.
—अवगुण्ठित-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्,
having the face veiled.

अवगुण्डित अव-गुण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded,
ground, pulverulent.

अवगुर् अव-गुर्, cl. 6. A. -गुरते, -रितुम्,
to assail with threats, to attack, to raise a weapon for
the purpose of striking a blow.

अव-गोरण, अम्, n. menacing, assaulting with in-
tent to kill, assailing with weapons.

अवगुह् अव-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते,
गूहितुम्, -गोढुम्, to cover; to hide, conceal; to
put into or inside; to embrace.
अव-गूहन, अम्, n. hiding, concealing, embracing.

अवगॄ अव-गॄ, cl. 6. A. -गिरते or -गिलते,
-गरितुम् or -गलितुम्, -गरीतुम् or -गलीतुम्, to
swallow up.
अव-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed up.

अवगै अव-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्,
to sing in a discordant tone, sing depreciatingly, sa-
tirize in song, reproach, revile.

अव-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung in a discordant tone,
sung badly; sung depreciatingly, satirized in song,
destroyed by incantation; reproached, abused, cen-
sured; wicked, vile; seen frequently (= मुहुर्-
दृष्ट), sung of frequently, well known, ‘decan-
tatus;’ (अम्), n. satire in song; reproach, blame, bad
or discordant singing.

अवग्रह् अव-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
-णीते, or Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to let
loose, to let go; to divide; (in gram.) to break off,
separate, discontinue; to distinguish: Caus. P. -ग्रा-
हयति, -यितुम्, to knead, make dough.

अव-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructed, impeded, re-
strained.

1. अव-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (in gram.) separable.
.2. अव-गृह्य, ind. having separated, laying hold
with the feet, leaning against with force or violence.

अव-ग्रह, अस्, m. separation of the component
parts of a compound, or of other grammatical forms,
occurring in some Pāṭhas, e. g. in the Pada-text of
the Vedas; the mark or the interval of such a separa-
tion; the syllable or letter after which the separation
occurs; the chief member of a word so separated;
obstacle, impediment, restraint; drought; nature,
original temperament; a sort of knowledge, a false
idea (?); an imprecation or term of abuse; an ele-
phant's forehead; a herd of elephants; an iron hook
with which elephants are driven.

अव-ग्रहण, अम्, n. obstacle, impediment, re-
straint, disrespect.
अव-ग्राहम्, ind. in breaking off or discontinuing.

अवघट्ट् अव-घट्ट्, cl. 1. A. -घट्टते, -ट्टितुम्,
cl. 10. P. -घट्टयति, -यितुम्, to push or brush
away or off; to touch, feel, rub; to stir up.

अव-घट्ट, अस्, m. a hole in the ground, a cave,
a cavern.
अव-घट्टन, अम्, n. rubbing away or off.

अव-घट्टित, अम्, n. pushing or rubbing toge-
ther; rubbing off.

अवघात अव-घात, अस्, m. (rt. हन्), strik-
ing, hurting, killing; a violent or fatal blow; threshing
corn by bruising it with a wooden pestle in a mortar
of the same material.
अव-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking, killing.

अवघुष् अव-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -षि-
तुम्, to proclaim aloud; to convoke, send for, sum-
mon; to fill with cries or clamour.
अव-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, proclaimed, summoned.

अव-घोषण, अम्, n. crying, proclaiming, de-
nouncing.

अव-हेलित, अस्, आ, अम्, disrespected; (अम्), n.
disrespect.

अवह्वर अव-ह्वर, अस्, m. (rt. ह्वृ), a
crooked way; trick; deceit.

अवाकिन् अ-वाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ (rt. वच्), not
speaking.

1. अ-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, speechless, dumb.
—अवाक्-श्रुति,
इस्, इस्, इ, deaf and dumb.

अवाच् 2. अवाच्, आङ्, आची, आक् (fr. 2. अव and
अञ्च्), turned downwards, being or situated below,
lower than (with abl.); looking downwards, headlong;
south; (ई), f. the south quarter, the lower regions
[with अवाच् has been compared the Lat. au-ster for
ava-ster].

आवच् आ-वच्, cl. 3. P., Ved. -विवक्ति, -वक्-
तुम्, to invoke.

1. अ-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be addressed; im-
proper to be uttered; vile, bad; not distinctly
expressed.
—अवाच्य-ता, f. or अवाच्य-त्व, अम्, n.
impropriety; reproach, calumny.
—अवाच्य-देश, अस्,
m. unmentionable region, the vulva.
2. अवाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, southern, southerly.

अवाक्ष अवाक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. अक्ष for
अक्षि with अव), who or what looks down upon or
defends, a guardian, a keeper.

अवाग्र अवाग्र (अव-अग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
a bent top; stooping, bending, bowed.

अवाक्, ind. downwards; south, southward, southern.
—अवाक्-पुष्पी, f., N. of the plant Anethum Sowa
Roxb.
—अवाक्-शाख, अस्, आ, अम्, having the branches
turned downwards; epithet of the Ficus Religiosa.
—अ-
वाक्-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head downwards,
headlong.
—अवाग्-भाग, अस्, m. the part below.
—अवाङ्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, looking down or away,
having the face turned downwards, headlong; (अस्), m.,
N. of a weapon.
—अवाञ्-ज्ञान, अम्, n. disrespect.
अवा-च्छिद्य, ind. having snatched away.

अवाज् अवाज् (अव-अज्), cl. 1. P. अवाजति, -जि-
तुम्, to drive down, to throw down.
अवाजिन् अ-वाजिन्, ई, m., Ved. a bad horse.

अवात् अवात् (अव-अत्), cl. 1. P., Ved. अवातति,
तितुम्, to go down; (formed for the etym. of अवत,
q. v.)

आवत् आ-वत्, त्, f. (fr. 3. आ), Ved. proximity,
(opposed to परा-वत्.)
आ-वात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, blowing.
अवातित (अव-अत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, gone down.
अवातुल अ-वातुल, अस्, आ, अम्, not flatulent.

अवाद् अवाद् (अव-अद्), cl. 2. P., Ved. अवात्ति,
त्तुम्, to cause to eat food.

आवद् आ-वद्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -वदति, -दितुम्,
to shout at, invoke, celebrate.

अवादिन् अ-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, no speaker, no
disputer, one who does not prosecute or bring an
action, peaceable.

अवान् अवान् (अव-अन्), cl. 2. P. अवानिति,
नितुम्, to breathe or inhale.

अवान्तर अवान्तर (अव-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
situated between; included, involved.
—अवान्तर-
दिश्, क्, or अवान्तर-दिशा, f. an intermediate region
of the compass.
—अवान्तर-देश, अस्, m. a place
situated in an intermediate region.
अवान्तराम्, ind., Ved. between.

अवाप् अवाप् (अव-आप्), cl. 5. P. A. -आप्नोति,
-नुते, -आप्तुम्, to reach, enter; to receive; to attain,
obtain, gain; to get, suffer.

आवप् आ-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्-
तुम्, to sow, scatter; to pour out; to offer: Caus. P.
-वापयति, -यितुम्, to shave, cut off, trim.

अवाप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, reached, received, obtained,
got.
—अवाप्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, reaching, obtaining,
receiving, taking; entertaining (as a belief).
अवाप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or gained.
अवाप्ति, इस्, f. obtaining, getting, receiving.
1. अवाप्य, ind. having obtained.

2. अवाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained or gained;
unattainable, unobtainable (?).

अवापित अ-वापित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वप्), not
sown (as grain) but planted.

अवापोह् अवापोह् (अव-अप-ऊह्), cl. 1. P. A.
अवापोहति, -ते, -हितुम्, to remove.

अवारण अ-वारण, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वृ), in-
curable, not to be remedied.

आ-वरण, अस्, आ, अम्, covering, hiding, concealing;
(अम्), n. covering, concealing, hiding; shutting, en-
closing; an obstruction, interruption; a covering, a
garment, cloth; anything that protects, an outer bar
or a fence, a wall; a shield; a bolt, lock; mental
blindness.
—आवरण-शक्ति, इस्, f. the power of illu-
sion, that which veils the real nature of things.

1. अवारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, treating of incurable
sicknesses.
2. अ-वारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be warded off.
अवारिका, f., N. of the plant Coriandrum Sativum.

अ-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, unimpeded, unobstructed;
innumerable.
—अवारित-द्वार, अस्, आ, अम्, having
open doors.

अ-वारितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be impeded or
hindered, not to be kept off.

अवार्छ् अवार्छ् (अव-ऋछ्), cl. 6. P., Ved.
अवार्च्छति, -च्छितुम्, to unharness, to fall down.

अवार्ज् अवार्ज् (अव-अर्ज्), cl. 1. P., Ved. अवार्-
जति, -जितुम्, to dismiss.

अवालोच् अवा-लोच् (अव-आ-लोच्), cl. 1. A.
-लोचते, -चितुम्, to consider.

अवावट अवावट, अस्, m. the son of a
woman by any other man than her first husband.
अवावन् अवावन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. ओण्), a thief.

अवास्तव अ-वास्तव or अ-वास्तविक, अस्, ई, अम्,
unsubstantial, unreal; fictitious; unfounded, irrational
(as an argument).

अवाहन अ-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having no
no team or carriage, not driving in a carriage.
आ-वहन, अम्, n. bringing near.

आ-वाहन, अम्, n. sending for, inviting, calling;
offering oblations with fire; (ई), f. a particular position
of the hands, the palms being placed together, and
the thumbs turned towards the root of the ring-finger.

आवनेय आवनेय, अस्, m. (fr. अवनि), son of
the earth; epithet of the planet Mars.

आवन्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from or being in the
country Avanti; (अस्), m. a prince or an inhabitant
of Avanti or of Oujein; the offspring of a degraded
Brāhman.
आ-वपन्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. scattering.

आ-वाप, अस्, आ, अम्, scattering, throwing; (अस्), m.
scattering, throwing; sowing seed; casting, directing;
(in pharmacy) throwing additional ingredients into
any compound in course of preparation; mixing, in-
serting; setting out or arranging vessels, jars, &c.;
a kind of drink; a bracelet; a basin for water round
the root of a tree; uneven ground; hostile purpose,
intention of going to war; a vessel; principal oblation
to fire.
आवाप आवाप, &c. See under आ-वप्.

आवापिक, अस्, आ, अम्, additional, inserted, supple-
mentary.

आवरसमक आवरसमक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अवर-
सम), to be paid in the following year.
आवर्जित आ-वर्जित. See under आ-वृज्.

आ-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined, poured down,
made to flow downwards.
आवर्त आ-वर्त, &c. See under आ-वृत्.

आ-वर्त, अस्, m. turning, winding, turning round,
revolving; whirl, gulf, whirlpool; deliberation, revolv-
ing (in the mind); a lock of hair that curls backwards,
especially on a horse; the two depressions of the fore-
head above the eyebrows; a crowded place where
many men live close together; a kind of jewel; N. of
a form of cloud personified; (आ), f., N. of a river;
(अम्), n. a mineral substance, pyrites, marcasite.

आवर्हित आ-वर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, eradicated,
plucked up by the roots.

आवल्ग् आ-वल्ग्, cl. 1. P. A. -वल्गति, -ते,
-गितुम्, to spring, to jump, to leap up.
आवशीर आवशीर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

आ-वसति, इस्, f. the night, i. e. the time during
which one rests.

आवसथिक, अस्, ई, अम्, inhabiting a house, house-
hold, domestic; keeping a sacred fire in one's house.

आवस्थिक आवस्थिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. अव-
स्था), founded on circumstances, suitable, adapted to.

आवह् आ-वह्, cl. 1. P. -वहति, -वोढुम्, to
bring, to bring to pass: Caus. P. -वाहयति, -यितुम्,
to have brought, cause to be brought, send for; to
make one bring.
आ-वहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing, receiving.

आ-वहमान, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing along, bringing
near, followed by, succeeded, bringing in succession.

आवाल आवाल, अम्, n. a basin of water
round the foot of a tree. See आलवाल.

आ-वरक, अस्, आ, अम्, what covers or conceals, a
cover, a veil.
आ-वारि, इस्, m. a shop, a stall.

आ-वर्ज्य, ind. turning down slantwise, inclining,
pouring out.

आ-वर्तक, अस्, m. a kind of poisonous insect; N.
of a form of cloud personified; depression above the
frontal ridge or over the eyebrows; whirlpool; revo-
lution; revolution of the mind from the influence of
the senses; a curl of hair; (ई), f., N. of a creeping
plant.

आ-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be turned round or
whirled; to be reversed; to be repeated.
आ-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, stirred round.

आ-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, what whirls or turns upon itself;
returning; (ई), m. a horse having curls of hair on
various parts of his body, considered as a lucky
mark; (इनी), f. a whirlpool; N. of the plant Odina
Pinnata.
अव-कीलक, अस्, m. a peg, nail.
अव-जिति, इस्, f. conquering, conquest.
अव-दोल, अस्, m. shaking, swinging.
अव-द्यत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breaking off.
अवर-शिला to be erased, B. R.
अव-लोप, अस्, m. breaking off, destruction.
अव-सायक, अस्, इका, अम्, destructive, fatal, deadly.
अव-हारिक, अम्, n. spoil, booty, plunder.
आ-वर्जन, अम्, n. victory, conquest (= जय).
